# Avatar

> A person or a client as a small circle. Their photo, or their initials on grey when there's no photo.

## Install

It lands in `src/rost/avatar/`, with what it needs and its contract. In an app that uses shadcn:

```sh
npx shadcn add https://rost.build/r/avatar.json
```

Then import `src/rost/fonts.css` and `src/rost/tokens.css` once, at the root of the app. More on this in [Install](../INSTALL.md).

| Prop | Type | Values | Default |
|---|---|---|---|

| `decorative` | boolean |  | `false` |

## Anatomy

- `root`: A `<span>`. With a photo it's the image's frame; without one it's `role="img"` with the name as its label, so the initials aren't read out letter by letter.
- `initials`: Medium weight, in the main text colour. Hidden from screen readers, since the root says the whole name.
- `image`: The photo, cropped to the circle.

## When to use

- **Who did it.** Next to a name in a list, a comment or an activity line, so people find each other at a glance.
- **A client.** A client's logo or initials in a table row.

## When not to use

- **A testimonial.** The quote's picture. That's **TestimonialPicture**, which has its own frame.
- **Status.** Saying if someone is online or late. Put a **Badge** beside it, not a colour on it.

## Behaviour

A photo when there is one, initials on grey when there isn't. The grey is the same for everyone. I didn't give each person a colour of their own: it reads as meaning something when it doesn't.

## Accessibility

- **Element**: With a photo, an `<img>` with the name as `alt`. Without, a `<span role="img">` labelled with the name.
- **Name**: The person's or the client's name. If the name is written right beside it, pass `decorative` so it isn't said twice.
- **Colour**: The initials are 9:1 on the grey in dark.

## Content

Initials come from the name, up to two letters. Don't pass them yourself.
